page.overview:
Who is Dave?

Dave is a supporting character of the Netflix series, Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as a major character of Season 1, a mentioned character of Seasons 2 and 3, and a supporting character of Season 5. His character is voiced by Glen Powell.

Dave is known for being both a slacker and a goofball, and somewhat of a prankster, hoping to be recognized for his comedic genius. However, when the lives of the kids are in danger before and after the Jurassic World Incident, he shows just as much seriousness in helping the kids than Roxie.

Dave is a camp counselor at Camp Cretaceous. Unlike the assertive and at times strict Roxie, Dave is shown to be funny, laidback and a goofball. Despite his laidback personality, he shows a lot of seriousness and at times assertiveness when the kids lives are in danger, most notably yelling at Darius and Kenji for sneaking into a Velociraptor Paddock, where they were nearly attacked.

When the Indominus rex escapes, he and Roxie are in waiting to talk to Claire Dearing. After Roxie picks the lock of a cabinet revealing sets of ACU walkie-talkies, they hear roaring and screams over the radios, and the life monitors turn red. He and Roxie set out to find the kids, tracking their ACU tablet. However, when the signal disappears after the tablet falls into the water due to a Mosasaurus attack in the Jurassic World Lagoon, both Dave and Roxy are frightened and concerned. Later, when they arrive at the Lagoon, they notice the kids on the monorail. They yell out to them, but to no avail, as the kids don't notice them. The two then leave after hearing Toro's roar.
